narrative: CISA formally tracked an inference-proxy and agentic-tool CVE - the LiteLLM MCP-endpoint flaw - on a KEV remediation timeline, advancing the federal-governance side of this thesis that the agent tool-wiring layer is an internet-reachable surface needing patch deadlines.
